title: MZ Looking for a plugin for permanent states for rpg maker mz

posts.author: Th3L1ttle3Man
posts.body: I have been struggling for like 2-3 hours straight of trying to find out if there's an existing plugin or script for this, can someone please help me.

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
Hime has the permanent state that I think you are missing.
http://himeworks.com/2013/03/10/permanent-states/
Credit to
Tsukihime
here:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/permanent-states.10201/
There was also the Yanfly plugin that had this, but it might have been moved over to the Visustella. It was for stat allocation and custom stats. For example, let suppose you created a character that was a shapeshifter. At level 17, (s)he can transform into a flame slime. The flame slime transformation is permanent until the next transformation. After gaining flame slime, the flame element is applied to all attacks. It would be useful for that.

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
Both the Hime and the Tsukihime suggestions made by
@Freedom
are scripts for VXAce, not plugins for MZ.  They cannot be made to work in MZ as they are written in Ruby, not JavaScript, and for an engine which is coded quite differently.
How exactly are you defining a 'permanent' state?  Is it the same as a passive?  Or simply one which is not removed at an Inn/Recover All event?

The latter, and I also want to keep the state after death as well.

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
If you have the (free) VisuStella plugin Skills & States Core this is quickly done with note tags.
<No Death Clear>
<No Recover All Clear>
However, to use this, you would also need to have the VisuStella Core Engine (also free).  I'm sure that there must be a way of doing it without using these particular plugins, but unfortunately I don't know what it is.  You'll have to wait until someone more knowledgeable comes along.
